quote.text: A man must not only consider how daily his life wasteth and decreaseth, but this also, that if he live long, he cannot be certain, whether his understanding shall continue so able and sufficient, for either discreet consideration, in matter of businesses; or for contemplation: it being the thing, whereon true knowledge of things both divine and human, doth depend.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that time is fleeting with our children, and every moment is precious; invest it wisely in nurturing their growth and curiosity before both your energies and their childhood fade away.
    • Understand that just as a parent's wisdom may evolve, so too does the way we support our kids—remain adaptable and continually seek to learn and adjust your approach to guide them effectively.
  • Leadership
    • Be ever mindful that each day offers diminishing opportunities—use your leadership not merely to allocate tasks, but to cultivate vision and wisdom that will endure beyond transient challenges.
    • Accept that even the most accomplished leaders experience limits in understanding; embrace continuous learning and reflective decision-making to inspire trust and clarity among your peers.
  • Product Management
    • View your daily decisions regarding product direction as critical investments in the long-term understanding of both market dynamics and user needs, even as industry trends shift rapidly.
    • Maintain an agile mindset, knowing that the product landscape can diminish or enhance your insights over time—regularly assess and iterate on strategies while balancing visionary goals with practical execution.
